title: R(4,23) >= 320: a 319-vertex Ramsey graph
description:
A graph on 319 vertices with no K4 and no independent set of size 23, so R(4,23) ≥ 320. No source we could find prints a value for R(4,23); 319 is what published rules give (the Burr-Erdős-Faudree-Schelp step from R(4,22) ≥ 314). The gain is +1.

The graph adds six vertices to the quartic-residue circulant on 313 vertices (Li, Su, Luo and Wu, unpublished 2011; Lindsay and Cain, arXiv 2015) by Theorem TB, a conditional k = 4 variant of Theorem 3 of Xu, Shao and Radziszowski (SIAM J. Discrete Math. 25 (2011)) in which the twin block is independent. Its condition, alpha(H - N(T)) ≤ alpha(H) - 2 for a triangle T, holds here with alpha(H - N(T)) = 19. Both the clique side and the independent-set side are checked directly on the finished graph by three separately written exact programs; the proof of the rule and a randomized test of its exact condition are included.
release_notes:
R(4,23) >= 320 (319-vertex graph) by Theorem TB (conditional k = 4 variant of Xu-Shao-Radziszowski 2011 Theorem 3) on the quartic-residue circulant Q313.
Includes a standard-library builder, an exact decomposition, three exact checkers with logs, the rule test and reproduce.sh.
